# Vendored shadcn stylesheet

`shadcn-tailwind.css` is copied unchanged from `shadcn@4.21.0`, `dist/tailwind.css`, distributed at https://registry.npmjs.org/shadcn/-/shadcn-4.21.0.tgz. Its MIT license is retained in `shadcn-LICENSE.md`.

This preserves existing utilities and state variants without installing the shadcn command-line package and its transitive tooling as runtime dependencies. Updating this stylesheet should be an explicit reviewed change.
